slides.title: Armed raid on a sugar factory
slides.body: Finchaa Sugar Factory compound, Sulula Finchaa district, western Oromia

slides.title: people reported killed
slides.body: on Oct 21: four local militia members and one unarmed civilian, community members told DW Amharic, Borkena reported.

slides.title: factory employees abducted
slides.body: during the raid. Their whereabouts and safety remain unknown, according to community sources.

slides.title: Vehicles burned, a bank vandalized
slides.body: Four vehicles and many motorcycles were set on fire and a Commercial Bank of Ethiopia branch was broken into. The attackers were not identified.

slides.title: Release the abducted. Protect civilians.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
